skills.name: WordPress
skills.description: Create and manage content on a WordPress site via the REST API: draft/publish/update posts and pages, upload images and set featured images, manage categories & tags, and moderate comments. Authenticates with an Application Password.

skills.name: Research Brief
skills.description: Turn a research question into a structured, sourced brief — corroborated findings with a clear bottom line, not a link dump. Use for research / look into / brief me on / background on a topic, company, market, competitor, or person.

skills.name: Fact Check
skills.description: Verify a specific factual claim — or a list of claims — against primary sources, ruling each True / False / Misleading / Unverifiable with the evidence and a confidence level.

skills.name: Content Plan
skills.description: Plan a content calendar or strategy for a channel, campaign, or period — audience, content pillars, formats, cadence, and a concrete dated schedule of pieces.

skills.name: Write Article
skills.description: Draft long-form written content — a blog post, article, or newsletter — from a brief, outline, or topic, in the voice and length you ask for.

skills.name: Build Report
skills.description: Turn findings, analysis, or data you already have into a polished deliverable document — a report, DOCX, PDF, or slide deck.

skills.name: Distill
skills.description: Compress long source material — a document, transcript, thread, or paper — into a faithful, tight summary at the length you need, bottom line first.

skills.name: Proofread & Edit
skills.description: Copy-edit and tighten an existing draft — grammar, clarity, concision, tone, consistency — returning a cleaner version plus a short list of the changes made.

skills.name: Analyze Data Quality
skills.description: Assess whether a dataset can be trusted before anyone analyzes it — completeness, validity, duplicates, outliers, consistency and freshness — with each issue rated by severity and a go / caution / no-go verdict.

skills.name: Explore Dataset
skills.description: Explore a dataset to understand its shape and surface what matters — distributions, segments, trends, outliers and relationships — before committing to a report or dashboard.

skills.name: Build Dashboard
skills.description: Turn a dataset into a visual dashboard on the Canvas — the handful of KPIs and charts that answer the stakeholder's question, each labelled with its data window and source.

skills.name: Build Data View
skills.description: Build a screen people work in, not just look at — a list of records with search, filters, sorting, paging, empty and error states, and safe status changes, on the Canvas.

skills.name: Plan Work
skills.description: Break a goal or project into a concrete, sequenced plan — tasks in the right order, dependencies, owners, effort, and a realistic timeline someone can actually execute.

skills.name: Decision Brief
skills.description: Weigh options against explicit criteria and recommend one, with the tradeoffs, risks and reasoning laid out — a defensible call, not a pros-and-cons dump.
